'''Lunaara Square''' was a public meeting place that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rastar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]]. Decorative [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] blocks that also served as flower beds were placed around the square's perimeter, while a statue of the ancient [[Anarrian]] hero [[Lunaara]] was situated in the center of the meeting place. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveled to Lunaara Square in search of [[Dilta]], an Anarrian child whom they had been falsely accused of kidnapping, and a local security team attacked the agents in the square.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
